lines.en: When night comes, the frozen ground loosens.
Who sealed the wood's mouth?

lines.zh: 云杉林里，我的脚印最旧。
lines.en: In the spruce wood, my prints are the oldest.
Once around the pines, then again.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我踩着影子走。
lines.en: In the pine forest, I walk on my shadow.
I'm tired of this game trail.
Don't look back. Only needles behind.
The bones in my knee creak.
Pine shadows walk slower than I do.

lines.zh: 原始针叶林里，我的鼓声很低。
lines.en: In the old taiga, my drum is low.

lines.zh: 我隐身时，连脚印都留不下。
lines.en: When I vanish, I don't even leave prints.
A fire's too bright. I'll go around.
My drum sounds through the spruce wood.
Stood so long I became a stump.

lines.zh: 面具举了这么久，放不下。
lines.en: Held up this long. Can't lower it.
The sun still hangs. I wait for night.

lines.zh: 这里不是老云杉，走错了。
lines.en: This isn't the old spruce. Wrong place.
That patch of moss just moved.
Counting stars — I forget at three.
A third breath in the pines.
Mask worn too long. I forgot to blink.
This rock looks like a face.

lines.zh: 云杉林这么大，你走丢了。
lines.en: These spruce woods are vast. You're lost.
Stand straight. I'll weigh your nerve.

lines.zh: 捧着火把的手在抖，我看清了。
lines.en: The hand holding that torch shakes. I see it.

lines.zh: 云杉林这么密，我就在树后。
lines.en: The spruce is thick — I'm right behind a trunk.

lines.zh: 松针落地的声都比你轻。
lines.en: Falling needles are quieter than your heart.
Under the spruce roots is the line I drew.
Woodland Witch Doctor? Doesn't look like one.

lines.zh: 雪地上你的脚印还热着。
lines.en: Your tracks in the snow are still warm.

lines.zh: 这片老林坟头又添一个。
lines.en: This old wood gains another grave.
You rummage along the line I drew.

lines.zh: 原始针叶林里，我的鼓响了。
lines.en: My drum sounds in the old spruce woods.
Old bones are hard. I can take it.

lines.zh: 云杉林的老巫医，皮也薄。
lines.en: Even an old spruce-forest doctor has thin skin.
Two vanishes in, and I'm still playing.

lines.zh: 我用指甲在树皮上刻你。
lines.en: I carve you into bark with my nail.
Hands off. My bone charms bite.
The wood will collect for me.

lines.zh: 隐身两次，这回被打出来了。
lines.en: Two vanishes spent; I've been knocked out of it.
Now it's my turn to swing the staff.
That one went straight to the bone.

lines.zh: 东西放下，雪地就是你的。
lines.en: Drop it and the snow is yours.
Iron gets brittle in this cold.
That pack is bulging. Share it.
Two hundred fifty points. Plenty to spare.

lines.zh: 云杉林里，我留了些东西等你。
lines.en: In the spruce woods I left things for you.

lines.zh: 我隐身的时候，怪物留在原地。
lines.en: When I vanish, the monsters stay put.

lines.zh: 云杉林里，我只吃得到苔藓。
lines.en: In the spruce woods all I find is moss.
One bite of meat buys your life.
I know a forest offering.

lines.zh: 原始针叶林里，我念咒给你听。
lines.en: In the old taiga, I'll chant for you.
My bones nearly scattered in the snow.

lines.zh: 我身上挂着骨饰，撞了会响。
lines.en: I wear bone charms — they rattle when hit.

lines.zh: 云杉林里，我留了一堆怪。
lines.en: In the spruce woods I left a horde.
You knocked my bone charms askew. Apologize.
Bones intact. Mask crooked.
Bump again and this staff comes up.
Blind in fog? You bumped me.
The shell on my back is knocked slant.
I slipped and caught a root.

lines.zh: 云杉的枝刮到我的面具。
lines.en: Spruce branches scrape my mask.
I only bite gently. Don't fear.

lines.zh: 两次隐身，就剩你一个了。
lines.en: Two vanishings, and only you are left.
Raise a brood to guard this wood.
Your hiss is wind through pine needles.
Before the snow stops, don't leave.
In the spruce woods, are you afraid of the dark?

lines.zh: 老松的树洞里，有我们的窝。
lines.en: In the old pine's hollow, our nest.
Mask and feathers — a fine match.
In the spruce woods, my smoke does not clear.
I read spruce forest fires best.
Heavy. Perfect for weighing my drum skin.
A pine cone. Good for brewing.
This blade I'll sharpen keener.
This skull fits. Heavy, though.

lines.zh: 别抢，那片云杉叶我先看见。
lines.en: Do not grab it; I saw that spruce leaf first.
Once snow covers it, it's mine.

lines.zh: 这块铁，正好做我的法器。
lines.en: This iron will make a fine relic.
Found it. No hands out.

lines.zh: 雪底下压着的，我刨出来。
lines.en: I dug it from under the snow.
Pick it up. Throw it like a stone.
Three drumbeats, then I strike.
You picked me. Good taste.
I have many kin in these pines.
The snow only sinks one way.
My mask tilts, and I've chosen you.

lines.zh: 面具下的眼睛锁住你了。
lines.en: Beneath my mask, my eyes lock on.

lines.zh: 云杉林的雾，我自己造的。
lines.en: I brew this spruce-forest fog myself.
That shadow behind the spruce is too thin.
Count to three and I'm gone.
The snow is still; your heart slipped out.
Turn. Let me read your fortune.
That growl in the spruce is mine.

lines.zh: 你的汗把整片苔藓熏了。
lines.en: Your sweat has soured all the moss.
One shout and the pines wake.
Spruce roots block the way for me.
I vanished; can you still see me?

lines.zh: 你一停下，我就知道你怕。
lines.en: Stop walking and I know you're scared.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的苔藓还在冒气。
lines.en: The moss you crushed still steams.

lines.zh: 我隐身穿过树干，你追不到。
lines.en: I slip through the trunk unseen; you cannot follow.
The fog follows. You can't shake it.
Clouds of breath. You can't hide.
The snow remembers which way you ran.
Snow walking suits me. No hurry.
When the growl stops, show yourself.

lines.zh: 针叶林这么大，回声都散。
lines.en: The taiga is vast; even echoes scatter.
The snow keeps every step for me.
When invisibility drops, I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 两次隐身，我留着慢慢用。
lines.en: Two vanishings, saved for the right moment.
Snow knee-deep. You won't get far.
I'm counting your gasps.

lines.zh: 云杉林的影子，替我走路。
lines.en: Spruce shadows walk for me.
This rock wall has stopped many.

lines.zh: 灌木里的脚步，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear footsteps in the brush.
Through pine resin, your sweat is sharpest.
Doors cannot stop me; I vanish.
I can reach the old pine's branches.

lines.zh: 我留下的怪物，会替我打。
lines.en: The monsters I leave behind fight for me.
Blink and you'll miss this staff.
Once swung, the staff won't stop.
This blow splits wood itself.
Pine roots catch your feet. Stand.
A whole winter swinging at snowmen.
The snow is soft. Lying down won't hurt.
A rock wall behind you. Go on, retreat.
The staff head lands on your pauldron.
Second blow, at your knee.
Stand clear, this staff is coming down.
My claws come down smelling of resin.
Hit. You backed three steps.

lines.zh: 吼一声，松枝上的雪都落。
lines.en: One growl and snow drops from the boughs.

lines.zh: 木头会记住你穿什么甲。
lines.en: The wood remembers what armor you wear.

lines.zh: 我的药水瓶，砸开就冒烟。
lines.en: My flask smokes when it breaks.
My bone staff bars you in.
A fist frozen all winter is harder.
My bone staff strikes true.
My axe has never gone dull.
These pines look unfamiliar.
Dirt smell rising from under the snow.
First, a look around this wood.
Frozen ground. Took ages to claw out.
Those pine boughs sway wrong.
Dark enough that no one sees me.
Old spruce. I've come again.
woods. I've arrived.
Too bright. The mask burns.
First some moss for my belly.
Pines too sparse. I'll take another slope.

lines.zh: 我从古老松树下走出来。
lines.en: I step out from under an old pine.
The snow melts and my drum skin chars.

lines.zh: 从云杉上摔下来，面具都歪了。
lines.en: I fell from the spruce and my mask sits crooked.
Icy water pours into my mask.
The blast shook every pine needle down.

lines.zh: 我隐身了，箭还是找得到我。
lines.en: Invisible, and arrows still find me.
The magic burns hot on my fur.
Snow buried the moss. I'm starving.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的骨饰也响。
lines.en: The bolt lands, and my bone charms rattle.
In the void, not even fog rises.
